record_type_quote: Mindset theory predicts that whether students believe basic ability is greatly malleable exerts a major influence on their own educational attainment (Blackwell, Trzesniewski, & Dweck, 2007). We tested this prediction in two near-replication studies (total n = 832).

targets.outcome_quote: Jointly, these two near-replication studies suggest that, even across challenging transitions, growth mindset is either unrelated to educational attainment or has a very small negative influence.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The original predicted a positive effect; the two new studies jointly report no positive relationship, contrary to prediction. Reference title and DOI are absent from the abstract.
